summary.ru: Тюргешский каганат — тюркское государство, основанное Ушликом, существовавшим в период VIII века на территории Семиречья.
summary.en: The Türgesh or Türgish were a Turkic tribal confederation. Once belonging to the Duolu wing of the Western Turkic On Oq elites, Türgeshes emerged as an independent power after the demise of the Western Turks and established a khaganate in 699. The Türgesh Khaganate lasted until 766 when the Karluks defeated them. Türgesh and Göktürks were related through marriage.
